_comment: Captured 2026-09-22 from the real rocky binary (default features, engine commit acdf093e6b4404b2f6f0e004e2a4ee4963a176db on branch fix/1941-check-name-collision, `rocky --version` reported 'rocky 1.74.0') against the minimal DuckDB project in `rocky_toml` below. Commands: `rocky --config rocky.toml --output json run --filter source=orders` and `rocky --config rocky.toml --output json plan --filter source=orders` (env ROCKY_SUPPRESS_DEPRECATION=1, matching rocky_sdk.client.RockyClient's own env) -- both produced byte-identical stdout/stderr/exit-code, because the collision is caught at CONFIG LOAD (rocky_core::config::validate_checks -> ConfigError::DuplicateCheckName), before either command reaches discovery. The custom check name and the null_rate column name are both table-independent producers (a custom check runs on every materialized table; so does every null_rate column), so this pair never reaches the newer post-discovery refuse_check_name_collisions guard added in engine/crates/rocky-cli/src/commands/run.rs for rocky-data/rocky#1941 -- that guard only fires for a collision config load cannot see (e.g. cross_source_overlap). Re-verified byte-identical (same returncode/stdout/stderr) after rebasing the branch onto main commit 200f580b ('rocky validate catches five wrong config shapes (#2152)') and rebuilding -- that PR added V002/V049/V054/V055/V056 to rocky-cli's validate.rs directly, not to rocky-core's CONFIG_VALIDATORS chain, so it does not change which guard fires here. Re-verify again after any future rebase that touches rocky-core/src/config.rs's CONFIG_VALIDATORS chain or validate_checks.
rocky_toml:
# Minimal repro for #1941: a custom check name and a null_rate column name
# that sanitize to the same Dagster check name.

[adapter]
type = "duckdb"
path = "repro.duckdb"

[pipeline.bronze]
strategy = "full_refresh"
timestamp_column = "_updated_at"

[pipeline.bronze.source.discovery]
adapter = "default"

[pipeline.bronze.source.schema_pattern]
prefix = "raw__"
separator = "__"
components = ["source"]

[pipeline.bronze.target]
catalog_template = "repro"
schema_template = "staging__{source}"

[pipeline.bronze.target.governance]
auto_create_schemas = true

[pipeline.bronze.checks]
row_count = false
column_match = false
null_rate = { columns = ["id"], threshold = 0.1 }

[[pipeline.bronze.checks.custom]]
name = "null rate id"
sql = "SELECT 0"
threshold = 0
stderr_lines: Error: failed to load config from rocky.toml

[checks] custom "null rate id" and null_rate "null_rate:id" on every table pipeline "bronze" copies both sanitize to the Dagster check name "null_rate_id". Dagster keys check results by (asset_key, sanitized_name); the first spec wins and the second is silently dropped. Rename one of them.
